_about: The single authoritative list of names for EPD Commerce. Every other file in this repo points here instead of repeating definitions. If a name is not in this file, do not invent one. Use 'canonical' exactly as written, including capitalization. Replace anything in 'never' with 'canonical'.

brands.role: The commerce platform. Products, checkout, subscriptions, reporting, recovery, and agentic commerce.
brands.notes: EPDC is acceptable only in tight UI labels or metadata. EPD Commerce is a DBA of Easy Pay Direct LLC.

brands.role: The payment processor and parent company. Also the name of the fully underwritten processing option inside EPD Commerce.
never: EPD (as shorthand for Easy Pay Direct)
brands.notes: Never write 'EPD' alone to mean Easy Pay Direct. EPD Commerce and Easy Pay Direct are separate brands.

processing_options.role: Auto-boarded processing option for low-risk, lower-volume businesses.
processing_options.notes: Always name it 'Process Now' when the option is referenced. Descriptions like 'near-instant approval' may follow the name, not replace it.

processing_options.role: Fully underwritten merchant account option with white-glove service.
never: Merchant account (as the name of the option)
processing_options.notes: When comparing the two options, name it 'Easy Pay Direct'. 'Merchant account' is a description, not the option name.

approved_terms.meaning: The merchant account arrangement behind a merchant's payments. Process Now or Easy Pay Direct.
approved_terms.notes: Approved for EPD Commerce materials. Do not carry 'rail' into Easy Pay Direct merchant communications, which follow the Easy Pay Direct white label framework.

approved_terms.meaning: What the buyer uses at checkout: cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Venmo, ACH, buy now, pay later.
approved_terms.notes: Never confuse a processing rail with a payment method. Every listed payment method is available on both rails.

approved_terms.meaning: Shopping in which an AI agent acts on a person's behalf within the authority that person grants.
approved_terms.notes: Lowercase in running text. Capitalize only at the start of a sentence or in a title.

approved_terms.meaning: Installment payment methods at the cart.
approved_terms.notes: Spell out on first use. BNPL is acceptable after that or in tight labels.

capabilities_rule: Approved only with an explanation next to them. Never show a capability name on its own as a label or eyebrow without the one-line promise and supporting copy from messaging-kit/capabilities/. Order is always Transact, React, Analyze, Create (payments first).

never: AI landing pages (as the feature name)
features.notes: The site also describes these as 'one-click landing pages' and 'AI-optimized landing pages'. Those are approved descriptions, not alternate names.
